changelog: The configuration file has been updated.
Added the ability to load previous log files.
The entire panel has been redesigned to match the look of other Salazar Store scripts.
New side menu with grouped sections and live counters.
New statistic cards and redesigned charts.
Logs are now grouped by day for easier reading.
Details now open in a side panel instead of a separate window.
Notifications have a new look and no longer pile up on the screen.
The panel now uses a single dark theme.
Fixed the confirmation window opening behind the details window when deleting logs.
Fixed the lock icon not showing when the script is turned off.
